lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance centroids are arranged in approximately 10 discernible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with 3 to 5 spots per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity circular blobs are positioned at the intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal alignment planes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible; the primary medial carina displays a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6 distinct high-luminance blobs are visible in a sparse, irregular distribution within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A synthetic tagging device is anchored to the medial carina just posterior to the leading edge of the first dorsal fin, consisting of a metallic/light-colored tether and bulbous attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small high-luminance points that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank blobs.
